state_references.text: "condition": ["occurred(SC_SPINE_OpheliaHamletStarter)","CurrentTime < Time(1,13,00)","not demontripped","not dead(hamlet)","not dead(claudius)","not dead(gertrude)","not dead(polonius)","not viewedEnding(END_JoinQuince)","not viewedEnding(END_Revenge)"],

visible_sources.source:
This world wishes I had died. That was my original fate.
I could accept the way things were meant to be.
A simple fate. One where I follow the story to its end.
visible_sources.target:
这个世界希望我已经死去。那是我原本的命运。
我可以接受一切原本注定的样子。
一个简单的命运。我只需沿着故事走到结局。

visible_sources.source:
My family and I could leave Elsinore behind forever.
We are utterly without land, coffers, or a way to get by.
But at least we'd have each other.
visible_sources.target:
我和家人可以永远离开埃尔西诺。
我们没有土地，没有钱财，也没有谋生的办法。
但至少，我们还能彼此相依。

visible_sources.source:
The Queen is dead. Long live the Queen.
If I sat on the throne, I could create nearly any world I liked.
But that sort of power comes with a price.
visible_sources.target:
王后已死。女王万岁。
如果我坐上王位，几乎就能创造任何我想要的世界。
但这样的权力，是有代价的。

visible_sources.source:
I was always meant to rise beyond this world.
Besides, there isn't a way back. Not anymore.
Not after what I've done.
visible_sources.target:
我本就注定要超越这个世界。
况且，已经没有回头路了。再也没有了。
做过那些事后，我就回不去了。

visible_sources.source:
Hamlet will make a good King... with me at his side, that is.
Still, this world would cost me my family.
The heaviest price at all.
visible_sources.target:
哈姆雷特会成为一位好国王……当然，前提是有我在他身边。
可这个世界会让我失去家人。
那是最沉重的代价。

visible_sources.source:
I have the power to create the perfect world.
It might exist only in my mind, but it'd be real to me.
Some call it insanity. I call it closure.
visible_sources.target:
我有能力创造一个完美的世界。
它也许只存在于我的脑海，但对我而言，它就是真实的。
有人称之为疯狂。我称之为释怀。

visible_sources.source:
No, Quince. You may not leave. Not now. Not ever.
I'm not your prisoner anymore. You're mine.
Let's both live out eternity in this hell.
visible_sources.target:
不，昆斯。你不准离开。现在不准。永远不准。
我不再是你的囚徒。你才是我的囚徒。
就让我们一起在这地狱里度过永恒吧。

visible_sources.source:
I found a world where nobody's life was lost.
Fortinbras's assault was repelled... for now.
But the fires of war cannot be so easily doused.
visible_sources.target:
我找到了一个无人丧命的世界。
福丁布拉斯的进攻被击退了……暂时如此。
但战火没那么容易扑灭。

visible_sources.source:
Othello promised me the world, and I want to take it.
Quince warned me our time together is fated to end.
Is brilliant bliss worth the sorrow which follows?
visible_sources.target:
奥赛罗许诺给我整个世界，而我想接受。
昆斯警告我，我们相伴的时光注定会结束。
灿烂的幸福，值得用随之而来的悲伤换取吗？

visible_sources.source:
I have begun to yearn for the sea.
Grace may be volatile, but her heart is true.
With her at the helm, who knows where we might go?
visible_sources.target:
我开始向往大海。
格蕾丝或许喜怒无常，但她的心是真诚的。
由她掌舵，谁知道我们会去往何方？

visible_sources.source:
Fortinbras' arrival shatters my old life into pieces.
But I am left alive. I could leave Elsinore behind.
Where would I go if I were beholden to no one?
visible_sources.target:
福丁布拉斯的到来，将我过去的生活击得粉碎。
但我还活着。我可以离开埃尔西诺。
如果不再受任何人牵绊，我会去哪里？

visible_sources.source:
Guildenstern and Rosencrantz invited me on an adventure.
An endless caper, wherever the path might lead.
Life is short and brutal. Why not have fun?
visible_sources.target:
吉尔登斯吞和罗森克兰兹邀我一起冒险。
无论道路通向何处，这场嬉闹都永无止境。
人生短暂而残酷。何不寻些乐趣？

visible_sources.source:
Fortinbras will make Hamlet into a beautiful puppet king.
All of us will dance at Norway's behest.
But if it means we all live on, that might be worth the price.
visible_sources.target:
福丁布拉斯会把哈姆雷特变成一个漂亮的傀儡国王。
我们所有人都要听从挪威的摆布。
但如果这能让我们都活下去，也许值得付出这个代价。

visible_sources.source: Abandon current timeline and revisit the event that cemented this fate?
visible_sources.target: 放弃当前时间线，回到决定这一命运的事件？

visible_sources.source: Sacrifice Choice for Revenge? If you damage the book, you, Quince, and everyone else will be trapped for eternity. There will be no going back.
visible_sources.target: 为复仇放弃选择？ 如果你损坏这本书，你、昆斯和其他所有人都会永远被困住。 再也无法回头。

visible_sources.source: This world has not yet come to pass.

This will be inscribed as the true fate of Elsinore Castle, ending you from your endless loop.
There will be no turning back.
visible_sources.target:
这将被铭刻为埃尔西诺城堡真正的命运，让你摆脱无尽的循环。
再也无法回头。

visible_sources.source: What number is this? Two thousand? Three?
visible_sources.target: 这是第几次了？两千次？三千次？

visible_sources.source: What number is this? Two thousand? Three?
visible_sources.target: 这是第几次了？两千次？三千次？

visible_sources.source: I suppose it doesn't really matter anymore.
I suppose it doesn't really matter anymore.

visible_sources.target: 哈姆雷特从舞台左侧上场。
哈姆雷特从舞台左侧上场。

visible_sources.source: Maybe I'll just go back to sleep.
visible_sources.target: 也许我干脆接着睡算了。

visible_sources.source: Maybe I'll just go back to sleep.
visible_sources.target: 也许我干脆接着睡算了。

visible_sources.source: I hope Quince is as bored as I am.
visible_sources.target: 希望昆斯也跟我一样无聊。

visible_sources.source: I hope Quince is as bored as I am.
visible_sources.target: 希望昆斯也跟我一样无聊。

visible_sources.source: I know there's no going back from what I did. I don't regret burning that book.
visible_sources.target: 我知道，做了这件事就再也无法回头了。我不后悔烧掉那本书。

visible_sources.source: I know there's no going back from what I did. I don't regret burning that book.
visible_sources.target: 我知道，做了这件事就再也无法回头了。我不后悔烧掉那本书。

visible_sources.source: Every minute of these four days is like the brick of a cell wall. And I've memorized them all.
visible_sources.target: 这四天里的每一分钟，都像牢房墙上的一块砖。而我已经把它们全都记住了。

visible_sources.source: Every minute of these four days is like the brick of a cell wall. And I've memorized them all.
visible_sources.target: 这四天里的每一分钟，都像牢房墙上的一块砖。而我已经把它们全都记住了。

visible_sources.source: But it's worth it if Quince can never hurt anyone again.
visible_sources.target: 但只要昆斯再也不能伤害任何人，这就值得。

visible_sources.source: But it's worth it if Quince can never hurt anyone again.
visible_sources.target: 但只要昆斯再也不能伤害任何人，这就值得。

visible_sources.source: It has has to be worth it.
It has has to be worth it.

省略号保持非词汇原样；未执行任何存档业务或解锁/采用操作。
POSTEND_QuinceBookBurned的31句由并行主任务独立审查；此证据记录选择限制、界面与晨间14次发言。
